description: On each new or updated pull request, launch an agent asset selection with the PR number on the run's tags and announce it in Slack with approve/reject reactions seeded.

asset_keys.label: Asset Keys
asset_keys.description: Agent asset(s) to launch for each new/updated pull request (e.g. a PR-reviewer asset + its Slack-reply asset).

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var holding a GitHub token with read access to pull requests.

api_base_url.label: Api Base Url
api_base_url.description: API base URL. Change for GitHub Enterprise Server.

slack_channel.label: Slack Channel
slack_channel.description: Channel to announce new/updated pull requests in (either `C123ABC456` id or `#channel-name`).

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the bot's `xoxb-...` token. Needs `chat:write` + `reactions:read` + `reactions:write` + `channels:history`/`groups:history`.

approve_emoji.label: Approve Emoji
approve_emoji.description: Emoji name (no colons) a reaction-based approval uses.

reject_emoji.label: Reject Emoji
reject_emoji.description: Emoji name (no colons) a reaction-based rejection uses.

approver_allowlist.label: Approver Allowlist
approver_allowlist.description: Slack user IDs (`U123...`) allowed to vote on the posted thread (enforced by sensors/slack_pr_approval_watcher, which reads this from the message's own metadata). Leave unset to allow anyone in the channel to vote.

message_template.label: Message Template
message_template.description: Optional custom message template. Placeholders: {number}, {title}, {url}, {author}, {approve_emoji}, {reject_emoji}. Default: ':mag: Pull request <{url}|#{number} {title}> by {author}. Reviewing now. React :{approve_emoji}: to approve or :{reject_emoji}: to request changes.'

ping_users_on_post.label: Ping Users On Post
ping_users_on_post.description: Optional Slack user IDs to @-mention in the initial post.

branch_prefix.label: Branch Prefix
branch_prefix.description: Only pull requests whose head branch starts with this prefix are ever announced in Slack or launched as a review run -- never a human's PR or a bot's (e.g. dependabot's). Matches the branch_prefix assets/ai/github_pr_tools' propose_fix uses by default, so a paired reviewer agent only ever reviews its own fixer's PRs. Set to '' to watch every open PR (not recommended -- a review run can comment on or approve a PR).

announcements_per_tick.label: Announcements Per Tick
announcements_per_tick.description: Max new/updated PRs announced (Slack post + RunRequest) in one sensor tick. A Dagster+ sensor tick times out at 60 seconds; a backlog of many PRs (e.g. the first tick after turning this sensor on) posts one Slack message each and can blow through that. Unannounced PRs stay in the backlog (the cursor isn't advanced for them) and are picked up on a later tick.

skip_in_branch_deployments.label: Skip In Branch Deployments
skip_in_branch_deployments.description: Skip every tick while running inside a Dagster+ branch deployment (DAGSTER_CLOUD_IS_BRANCH_DEPLOYMENT=1). A branch deployment runs its own copy of every sensor alongside the full deployment's -- without this, a branch deployment double-announces PRs in Slack and double-launches review runs.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Chat platform to announce new/updated pull requests on. 'teams' posts via Microsoft Graph (an Adaptive Card attachment carries the PR-review correlation metadata instead of Slack's hidden message metadata) and pairs with sensors/teams_pr_approval_watcher instead of sensors/slack_pr_approval_watcher.

teams_team_id.label: Teams Team Id
teams_team_id.description: platform='teams' (required then). Teams team id (Teams client -> team -> ... -> Get link).

teams_channel_id.label: Teams Channel Id
teams_channel_id.description: platform='teams' (required then). Teams channel id inside the team (e.g. '19:xxx@thread.tacv2').

teams_tenant_id_env_var.label: Teams Tenant Id Env Var
teams_tenant_id_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the Azure AD tenant id.

teams_client_id_env_var.label: Teams Client Id Env Var
teams_client_id_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client id.

teams_client_secret_env_var.label: Teams Client Secret Env Var
teams_client_secret_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client secret.

teams_refresh_token_env_var.label: Teams Refresh Token Env Var
teams_refresh_token_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the OAuth refresh token.

teams_approve_reaction.label: Teams Approve Reaction
teams_approve_reaction.description: platform='teams'. Reaction type for a reaction-based approval. One of: like, heart, laugh, surprised, sad, angry (Graph's full reaction set).

teams_reject_reaction.label: Teams Reject Reaction
teams_reject_reaction.description: platform='teams'. Reaction type for a reaction-based rejection.

teams_approver_allowlist.label: Teams Approver Allowlist
teams_approver_allowlist.description: platform='teams'. Azure AD object IDs (GUIDs) allowed to vote on the posted card (enforced by sensors/teams_pr_approval_watcher). Leave unset to allow anyone in the channel to vote.
